comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: From round 1: (slot 2) pane.read is REFUSED until the headless terminal exists - serve it here, paged by absolute row (muster-vt now has Terminal::text(first,last), 196 ns/row). Publish cwd changes (OSC 7, falling back to the foreground process) as PaneChanged; records carry the start cwd until then; splits already inherit the live cwd. The reader to attach to is crates/muster-daemon/src/pane.rs drain(). (slot 1) Build the daemon with MUSTER_VT_LINK=static in an invocation that does not also build muster-seam; parse a handoff replay before set_effect_handler; drop feature 52 from Answers.primary_attributes when the clipboard-write setting denies writes, as Ghostty does; pick the kitty image store size deliberately (a store smaller than the surface's makes programs see errors the surface would not give).

creator: Alexander Terp
title: Pane streams: passthrough, credit, attach by replay, and daemon-side input
